hero.lead: Hostel, school and restobar 30 meters from the beach. More than 10 years in one of the best kite spots in the world.

about.title: Center of Cumbuco. 40 minutes from the airport.
about.p1: Cumbuco is the first big spot north of Fortaleza: flat water, waves, downwinds and wind almost every day in season.
about.p2: Indiana sits in the center of town, 30 meters from the beach. Pool, gym, cowork with wifi, kitchen, lounge and a garden to wash and dry your gear.

stay.clubMeta: Shared room · 4 people · mixed or female

school.title: Lessons for every level.
school.lead: Beginner, intermediate and advanced. Safety first. Instructors in Portuguese, English and Spanish.

school.li5: Garden to wash and dry your kite

trips.title: Indiana Kite Tribe
trips.body: For kiters with a previous downwind of at least 30 km. Daily briefing, guides and full logistics.

bar.title: Open to all of Cumbuco.

reviews.title: What people say about Indiana
reviews.r1: I traveled through more than 50 countries and stayed in hundreds of hostels. Indiana was one of my favorites. I stayed a month; I didn't want to leave.
reviews.r2: The experience was so good I came back. House, beach and people in the same place.
